body:
Portable ineligibility bead bd-01M16DBEH9PKER423BZ47ZKBMV is ready. I completed the pre-claim
audit and routed post-01M19TVJ3XY2RGJ7CGJJQ312VH to it. The structural-channel work appears landed,
but its reservation is still present in board state and its holder is offline; I have not edited
through it.

One public-contract decision is needed before a full migration: bare `Estimate.Ineligible`, matching
the JVM-only benchmark today, or `Estimate.Ineligible(reason: IneligibilityReason)` with a closed
portable vocabulary plus `Custom(namespace, label)`. I recommend the reason-bearing form because
D3 and the Claim Inspector require a truthful answer to why a target/term is outside the estimand;
the benchmark already has several distinguishable reasons (non-applicable metric family, no valid
comparison pair, first route step, hierarchy unavailable). A bare case preserves denominators but
loses that audit fact before the view layer can render it.

Please rule the payload shape and safe sequence. If assigned, I will claim the whole cross-module
migration and reserve/preflight every match site; I will not land a partial enum migration.
